svg.text: CSEEE-21 / Nano ESP32 controller / illustrative values, not a calibrated or tested build
C2/C3 close to U2 supply pins
At 25 C: R_NTC = 10 kohm, V_SENSE = 1.65 V.
As temperature rises, R_NTC and V_SENSE fall.
Example: 30 C target; start with slow PWM / time proportioning.
P_ON = V^2 / R = 6^2 / 3 = 12 W; P_AVG approximately duty x 12 W.
12 V directly across 3 ohm would produce 48 W, not 30 W.
All GND symbols share a return. Route heater current separately
from sensor/USB grounds to a common supply-return point.
Design example: verify actual pinouts, supply limits, thermistor calibration and available heating power before assembly.
U2 is an added driver, not confirmed in the supplied kit. NC pin 3 unconnected. SW1 shown open. All resistor values illustrative.
